verdicts.reason: A breaks the pill row: TASTINGS sits higher and is shaped differently from the others, with tiny text pushed to its top edge. The pills also differ in size. The date and location wrap awkwardly ('Harbour / Rooftop'), and the italic subtitle crowds 'Saturday'. B keeps the pills consistent and the date on one line, but the RSVP button and URL line sit left of centre to make room for the placeholder image, which is jammed against the URL text. The phone also floats loosely in the middle, and the subtitle is tight to the date.
